1967-12-20: Marshall Thundering Herd beat Virginia Cavaliers 97–89. Stone led the winners with 27 points. Mike Katos had 22 for Virginia Cavaliers. Allen grabbed 28 rebounds.
1981-12-29: New Mexico Lobos beat Marshall Thundering Herd 86–70 as Alan Jolensky scored a team-high 19. George Washington had 15 for Marshall Thundering Herd.
1989-11-25: Behind Smith, Bryant's 21 points, Virginia Cavaliers rolled past Marshall 83–63. Taft, John had 21 for Marshall.
